subject.title: fix(reef): discover trusted peers as conversations

question: After exact-head live Reef proof is supplied, should OpenClaw accept this additive Gateway method and the new unbound-conversation state as the canonical discovery contract?
rationale: The patch is functionally coherent, but protocol compatibility and persisted session-state semantics are maintainer-owned boundaries that automated tests and contributor proof cannot approve by themselves.

options.title: Approve the canonical contract
options.body: Require the live proof and refreshed checks, then accept Gateway-owned discovery with lazy session binding as the supported model.

options.title: Request a narrower Reef-only repair
options.body: Avoid the generic Gateway protocol change and ask for a Reef-scoped solution, accepting duplicated discovery ownership and reduced cross-channel consistency.

options.title: Defer the change
options.body: Keep the linked bug open until maintainers are ready to own the protocol and session-state compatibility surface.

recommendation.title: Approve the canonical contract
recommendation.body: Require the live proof and refreshed checks, then accept Gateway-owned discovery with lazy session binding as the supported model.
